metadata.description: Anti illusion-of-explanatory-depth toolkit: deep-coach (explain-first coaching with spaced review) and claim-validator (verification labels on every AI factual claim)

plugins.name: mind-vault
plugins.description: Two skills against the illusion of explanatory depth: deep-coach makes YOU explain concepts before the AI does (scores 1-5, fills gaps, logs to a versioned knowledge base with Notion mirror); claim-validator labels every factual claim in AI answers as verified/unverified/conflicting and verifies important claims against sources first.
